Steady Hand Relay.name: Steady Hand Relay
Steady Hand Relay.description: The user streams their own trained know-how into a single ally's mind, step by step and movement by movement, faster than speech. For the rest of the scene that ally performs one task the user knows, such as packing a wound, defusing a device or shoring a sagging beam, with the user's full skill, even with no training of their own. The user must stay focused on the link and can take no other action; if the ally is hurt while linked, the user feels it and takes heavy psychic damage. Strain: severe.
